content: `raw.githubusercontent.com` is blocked but `github.com` and `api.github.com` work. Let me try downloading via the API content endpoint:

arguments.command: curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/nvm-sh/nvm/contents/install.sh?ref=v0.40.8" 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json,base64; d=json.load(sys.stdin); open('/tmp/install_nvm.sh','w').write(base64.b64decode(d['content']).decode())" && echo "ok" && bash /tmp/install_nvm.sh 2>&1 | tail -6
